established: Complete poison application accepts positive rate and frame length, replaces equal/stronger rate and ignores weaker rate without refreshing expiry. Existing stat-list owner remains the original source on refresh; first creation captures attacker type/ID. Monster stat-regeneration event is rescheduled to next frame on every valid application, even weaker applications.

Complete player HP regeneration clamps to256FP256/one life. Monster regeneration writes exact FP256 life, can retain positive life below256 and kills only at zero; ordinary source kill/kill-credit events occur then. It does not dispatch ordinary damage for each nonlethal poison frame.

Monster life-mask state removes its base regeneration contribution. Prevent-heal does not block negative regeneration. A negative update below one life returns without health mutation in town; source large updates crossing zero from at least one life and delayed-death branches are separately covered.
limits: Stats/stat-list allocation/attachment/expiration, room/town/life-mask/state, game/event scheduling, max life, death/event and packet services are declared. Complete application/player/monster bodies execute, not the global modern event queue or final NPC death pipeline.

The combined regen stat is a declared input; source natural regeneration, potion/replenish interactions and current modern poison interruptions/damage-event ordering remain separate. Do not infer global40ms phase or complete modern same-frame source ownership from this fixture.

Native existing TimedEffects poison currently uses whole-HP ordinary Damage, changes source on accepted refresh, permits player death. The saved60second rejection is corrected separately by poison-duration-native-evidence.json; no other consumer difference is changed there. These remaining differences are recorded for a deliberate shared-consumer migration before certifying Poison Javelin.
